s.note: Charles trying his lines in an Oxford pub
s.how: Lay out 250g aged cheddar, 150g sliced ham, pickled onions, tomato chutney and a sliced green apple on a board. Add thick slices of crusty bread and a dish of butter.

s.note: the standoff off the coast of Cuba
s.how: Melt 60g butter, stir in 80g flour and whisk in 500ml milk until very thick. Add 200g chopped ham and chill overnight. Shape into logs, crumb in 2 eggs and 150g panko and fry until golden.

m.note: Sebastian Shaw's Hellfire Club in Las Vegas
m.how: Parboil 1kg potato chunks for 8 minutes, shake to rough up and roast in oil at 220C for 45 minutes. Season 2 x 500g rib eyes and sear in a very hot pan for 4 minutes a side, basting with 40g butter for the last minute. Rest 5 minutes. In the same pan, add 1 tbsp crushed peppercorns and 60ml brandy, then 200ml cream and 100ml beef stock, and simmer until thick. Slice and spoon over.

w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with half a tin of condensed milk and 20g butter and set in a lined tray. Repeat with 200g white chocolate and the rest of the milk in another tray. Cut into squares and arrange like a chess board.

d.note: the spy style of the early sixties
d.how: Put 4 martini glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Fill a jug with ice, add 240ml gin and 40ml dry vermouth, and stir steadily for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into the frozen glasses. Add a toothpick with 2 green olives to each. Drink straight away while it is ice cold. For a booze-free version, stir chilled tonic with a splash of olive brine.
